templates.credential_scope: Dedicated GitHub fine-grained credential: pull requests read, actions read, issues read; no contents write, administration, webhook, workflow dispatch, or deployment scope.
outputs: n8n execution view only; no external notification is configured
activation_prerequisites: Owner creates a dedicated read-only GitHub credential in n8n
Repository placeholders are replaced and reviewed
Manual test uses non-sensitive data and confirms redaction
Failure, retry, and notification behavior are reviewed
Owner explicitly approves import and activation
templates.rollback: Disable or delete the workflow in n8n, revoke the dedicated GitHub credential, and review executions for redacted error evidence.
